name: end_cap
title: Gearbox output end-cap: flanged, ribbed, bored, and bolted
description: A cast aluminium end-cap of the kind that closes a gearbox and carries the output shaft's bearing — the part exists to do four things at once, and every one of them is a different modelling idea:

parameters.name: rib_crest
